title: Normalized coordinate-line adjunction and its actual counit
statement:
Fix the finite datum of [def-pur-conventions]: $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, $n\geq1$, and $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. All bases below are separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Use the specified pro-etale Tate twists [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], constructible exceptional inverse image [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], and adjunction-preserving composition comparisons [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction, def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate].

Let $T$ be such a base, $p:X=\mathbf A^1_T\to T$, $j:X\hookrightarrow P=\mathbf P^1_T$ the standard chart, and $q:P\to T$, so $qj=p$ [def-sbc-affine-space, def-nagata-projective-space-base-change]. For any $a\geq1$ with $\ell^aA=0$ put $N=\ell^a$ and $L_U=\mu^{\mathrm{et}}_{N,U}\otimes_{\mathbf Z/N}A$, the ordinary etale line of [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback]. The schemes $T,X,P$ are Noetherian of finite dimension, $p$ is separated finite type, and $(j,q)$ is a compactification [def-amb-etale-compact-support]. The same assertions apply when $T=\mathbf A^r_B$, $r\geq0$. In the coordinate tower, $p_{r+1}=p_rq_r$, $z_{r+1}=s_rz_r$, $q_rs_r=1$, where $q_r$ forgets the last coordinate and $s_r$ sets it to zero. Coordinate divisors remain effective Cartier after every change of base, including nonreduced bases. One may take $a=n$; each $L_U$ and its tensor powers are locally free rank one, and their comparison pullbacks are the specified Tate powers.

Compose $Dj_!\dashv j^*$ with the projective-line adjunction normalized by $t_q$ of [lem-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-adjunction]. For $K\in D^b_{ctf}(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ its right adjoint is $G_pK=p^*K\otimes_A^L L_X[2]$, and its actual counit is
$$\epsilon_{p,K}=(1_K\otimes I_p)\operatorname{PF}_p^{-1},\qquad I_p=t_q\circ Rq_*(j_!L_X[2]\to L_P[2]),$$
with the tensor unit and symmetry conventions of [def-pur-affine-line-purity-comparison]. Here the first arrow defining $I_p$ is the extension-by-zero counit and $\operatorname{PF}_p$ is the canonical compact-support projection map [lem-weil-finite-compact-projection-formula]. The adjunction-preserving comparison $G_pK\to p^\times K$ with the ordinary compact-support right adjoint is the transpose of this displayed counit and is a natural isomorphism. Under the projection-induced site comparisons of [lem-pur-vector-integration-site-comparison], it is exactly the specified pro-etale map $\gamma_{p,\nu_T^*K}$ of [def-pur-affine-line-purity-comparison]. In particular $\gamma_{p,M}$ is a natural isomorphism for every $M\in D^b_{ctf}(T,A)$, at every $n$, independently of $a$.

proof.text: For T, its affine line, projective line, and every coordinate stage, use finite type over the field to obtain Noetherianity and a finite topological dimension bound. The affine projection is separated, quasi-compact and locally of finite type; the standard chart is open and projective projection proper. The affine-space API gives the two tower identities and the zero-section projection identity. Use the universal coordinate Cartier theorem for all bases.

proof.text: In the valuation ring of E, the norm of ell is less than one, so ell belongs to the maximal ideal. The uniformizer generates that ideal, hence ell^level belongs to its level-th power and vanishes in the coefficient quotient. For every annihilating exponent, invertibility of ell on the finite-type field scheme gives invertibility of its power. The ordinary finite-twist theorem supplies every rank-one cover; the root-normalized site twist theorem supplies the stipulated Tate comparison.

proof.text: Apply the coordinate-line counit tensor theorem. The ordinary right-adjoint comparison is conjugation of the identity; Mathlib conjugateEquiv_counit gives its actual counit equation. Injectivity of the inverse Hom equivalence gives its transpose formula. Thus all three clauses of NormalizedOrdinary hold.

proof.text: Use coordinate_line_augmentation_realization. Expand the six canonical Hom bijections of specifiedExceptionalHomEquiv. Naturality of the comparison adjunction and its unit rewrites the site transpose as comparison of the ordinary Brown transpose followed by boundedSiteRho and the target representative map. Naturality of Brown transposition in its source and the preceding conjugate transpose identity identify that ordinary transpose with sourceCoordinates followed by comparison. This is exactly comparedConjugate, so it equals the independently defined gamma.

Each other factor of comparedConjugate is an isomorphism by construction. Transport invertibility through the equality with gamma.
